fields.Name: T337 - Dry-Run Preview Flow
fields.Description: Exercises the flagship RecordProcessRunnerUX two-step safety flow (server dry-run → diff preview → user-gated Apply) via the editor Preview path — the signature bulk-operations behavior, exercised nowhere else.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open 'Bulk Operations', click 'New operation'. Build a minimal valid operation: type a Name (e.g. 'Test preview op'), select any Entity, then in the Rules section click 'Add rule', pick a target field, and give it a fixed value (leave source as 'a fixed value' and type something). Once 'Preview changes' is enabled, click it. A dry-run runner dialog should open showing a safe-preview message such as 'Computing a safe preview — no changes have been made yet…', then resolve to either a per-record diff preview (a summary like 'N of M will change' with an 'Apply … change(s)' button), a 'Nothing to change' empty state, or an error message about the preview. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the dry-run preview dialog open and resolve is success — you must NOT click Apply.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Preview changes' opens the runner dialog with a safe-preview / 'no changes have been made yet' indication
The dialog resolves to a preview outcome — a change summary with an 'Apply' action, a 'Nothing to change' state, or a clear error — without applying anything automatically
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages beyond an in-dialog preview error
